title: obione obovata
intro: Obione obovata, commonly known as  beach evening primrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Onagraceae.  It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving skin conditions due to its high content of essential fatty acids and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Obione obovata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Obione obovata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
